source_context: Bulk sandbox historical replay evidence pilot v0.2. Synthetic seed evidence for attribution-learning pipeline testing; not production evidence.
evidence_items: Singapore Electronics output in 2023 was influenced by inventory restocking, customer inventory, and channel inventory conditions.
Stockpiling and inventory correction affected production timing and order patterns.
Inventory drawdown and changing customer orders shaped manufacturing activity.
The sector reflected a portfolio effect rather than a pure demand signal.
